segments.name: Watch and Accessory Brands
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and distributes watches, jewelry and other accessories of owned and licensed brands to wholesale customers and consumers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company's Watch and Accessory Brands segment includes the designing, manufacturing and distribution of watches and, to a lesser extent, jewelry and other accessories, of quality owned and licensed brands, in addition to revenue generated from after-sales service activities and shipping.

segments.name: Company Stores
segments.description: Operates retail outlet stores in the United States and Canada and an online outlet store selling current and discontinued Company products.
segments.evidence: The Company Stores segment includes the Company's retail outlet business.

revenueModel.text: The Company is paid by department stores, jewelry chains, independent jewelers and e-commerce retailers for its watches and accessories, and by consumers through its owned e-commerce sites and outlet stores.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells all of its brands in the U.S. Watch and Accessory Brands market primarily to department stores, including Macy's and Nordstrom; major jewelry store chains, including Signet Jewelers, Ltd. and Helzberg Diamonds Corp.; independent jewelers; and third-party e-commerce retailers, including Amazon; as well as directly to consumers through the Company's owned e-commerce websites, including www.movado.com and www.mvmt.com.
